views.markdown: Customize your notification badges with adaptive colors, text colors and borders. iOS 26.

Requires iOS 26. Tested on iPhone 11 Pro Max, iOS 26.0.1, Dopamine 3 RootHide.

Rootless and native RootHide. Native RootHide installs directly without Patcher.

- Reuse cached icon colors when a new badge appears.
- Preserve the same icon's sampled color through badge count changes.
- Retry unavailable icon pixels early with a bounded recovery sequence.
- Keep valid background paint visible while the same icon's appearance refreshes.
- Reject stale callbacks after view reuse or a folder's highest-count app changes.
- Preserve static badge backgrounds, text colors, borders, highest-count folder coloring and safe animated badge updates.
